notes.title: v0.14.0 - Minor update to the game engine
notes.notes: This is a fairly small update in terms of actual features, and is mostly just an update to the underlying Unity engine to be on the latest version. Other small bug fixes and minor improvements are included.

notes.title: v0.13.1 - Major change to "Bracing"
notes.notes:
Things just got less frustrating. Previously, you could hold the Shift key to "Brace", which would make you resist forces (like Rift forces) and stay in one spot more easily. Not bracing usually meant getting pulled into a Rift, or flung all over the place. But I realized that A) New players didn't really understand this concept, and didn't use it enough, and got frustrated, and B) By the later levels, experienced players were just holding down the Shift key almost 100% of the time, which was more of a hassle than a skill.

So, with this update, Bracing is now automatic. Any time you're not actively walking in a direction, you'll automatically brace. This makes everything feel much more in control than it did before. 

For speedrunners, who appreciated the ability not to brace in cases where it helped them go faster, you can still have that experience, by making sure you're always holding down on a movement key if you want to bypass the Auto-Brace behavior.

notes.title: v0.13.0 - Three new levels, and major changes to the Demo
notes.notes:
The big feature in 0.13 is the addition of three new levels towards the start of the game. Look for "Tunnel Vision", "Run the Gauntlet", and "Virtual Velocity" in the level selection list, near the top.

These new levels extend the initial "Orientation Course" portion of the game, and are now included in the Demo. The Demo used to be a single level, taking maybe 5-10 minutes on average. The Demo now contains 4 levels, and is probably more like a 20-30 minute experience.

notes.title: v0.12.2 - More cutscene/story content
notes.notes: This release brings the story up to the end of the Advanced Training section of the game, which means about half of the existing levels now have their story content.

notes.title: 0.12.1-f2 - Bug fix for Research Labs levels
notes.notes: This is a minor bug fix release, which corrects a serious bug occurring in levels like "Red Shift".

notes.title: v0.12.1 - 8 new "Hard Mode" levels
notes.notes: 8 more levels have had Hard Mode versions added. Look for them under the Challenge Modes menu.

notes.title: v0.12.0 - New story dialogues, one new level, and 6 new 'Hard Mode' levels.
notes.notes: The main Story now runs up through the level 'Full Swing'. One brand-new level has been added to the 'Advanced Training' section, named 'Logic Gates'. And 6 levels have been upgraded with a 'Hard Mode' version.

notes.title: v0.11 - Introducing "Hard Mode"
notes.notes:
This update isn't for everyone... It introduces the start of a new layer of the game, where existing levels have had the difficulty ramped up to 11. Have fun revisiting familiar levels that now contain new and extreme challenges. 

I'm eventually planning on unlocking "Hard Mode" as a kind of "New Game+" feature, after you finish the game under its standard difficulty. But for now, in order to make it easier to get feedback from players, you'll find a new tab in the "Challenge Modes" screen. Give them a try, and don't be shy with the feedback.

For now, 9 levels have been upgraded with "Hard Mode", just the levels of the Basic Assessment course. The rest of the levels will follow, most likely pairing up with adding the remaining cutscenes/story to the levels.

notes.title: v0.10.0 - Major update with the start of the Story
notes.notes:
Character dialogue (with professional voice acting) has been added to the first 12 levels or so, with more to come in future updates. Each new major update will continue the story.

This release also includes a ton of other smaller changes, new secrets, major performance improvements.

Gravia now has about 65 levels, over 80 secrets to be found, with more to come.

notes.title: v0.8.13 - Weekly Time Trial
notes.notes: At the top of the Time Trial screen is the option to play the Weekly challenge. This is a procedurally generated level that changes each week. Compete for first place in this week's challenge before it goes away.

notes.notes: This small release adds one new level, "Ball Lightning", to the Research labs area.

notes.title: v0.8.10: New level - "Standard Model"
notes.notes: This release adds a new level in the Core Research area, 'Standard Model', along with some bug fixes and improvements based on feedback.

notes.title: v0.8.9 - Visual redesign of Basic Assessment and Combat Scenarios areas.
notes.notes:
In order to differentiate Gravia's visual aesthetic, I've redesigned two areas of the game that were looking the worst or just generic.

Other bug fixes and improvements based on playtesting.

notes.title: v0.8.8 - A huge batch of improvements and bug fixes based on recent playtesting
notes.notes: A big batch of changes based on February 2022 playtesting. Some of the key new features are: Improved subtitle options and improved destruction on rocky debris. The Basic Assessment course section of the game has also been consolidated and trimmed down, to keep that portion engaging.

notes.title: v0.8.6 - Two new levels: 'Ground Zero' and 'Red Shift'
notes.notes: This release mainly adds two new levels to the game. 'Ground Zero' is part of the Combat Scenarios section, while 'Red Shift' is in the 'Core Research' area.

notes.title: v0.8.5 - Added "Ghosts" to Challenge Mode
notes.notes:
This is a relatively small release, with the main new feature being "ghosts" being added to both Time Trial and Collector Mode level. "Ghosts" represent your personal best run in a level. When replaying one of these levels, your "ghost" will run through it, doing the same things it did in your best run. The purpose of the ghost is to give you a better sense of how you're doing compared to your best so far.

This release also fixes a few small bugs.

notes.title: v0.8.4 - Introducing "Collector Mode"
notes.notes:
The Main Menu now shows a 'Challenge Modes' button, which replaces the old 'Time Trial' button. The Challenge Modes screen lets you play either Time Trial levels, or the new 'Collector Mode' levels. Collector Mode levels are completely new levels where you rush to 'collect' as many of the spheres as you can before time runs out. Steam Leaderboard support is included for this mode.

This release adds just a two Collector Mode levels, so I can get some feedback before adding more. The first is available after completing 'Like a Glove'. The second is available after completing 'Orbital Mechanic'.

notes.title: v0.8.3 - Time Trial Leaderboards
notes.notes: The "Time Trial" game mode now uses the Steam Leaderboard system to show you how you rank against players from around the world. Time Trial is also available much earlier in the game now, unlocking after you complete the first "tutorial" level. Let's see who's fastest.

notes.title: v0.8.2 - Added two new "micro-gravity" levels in the Advanced Training area
notes.notes:
Added two new levels, "Floating Point" and "Orbital Mechanic", to the Advanced Training portion of the game. Also added a loading bar when loading levels, to let players with slower systems know that progress is occurring.

See full patch notes in game.

notes.title: v0.8.0 - Five new levels, and performance improvements
notes.notes:
This initial 0.8 release introduces the "Core Research" wing, the next major area of the game, featuring five new levels so far. Please submit any feedback you have on the new levels. I'm sure they still need a lot of work.

Level load/reload times have also been dramatically improved. It should now take significantly less time to load most levels and to restart after dying.

Note: This initial 0.8 release is for Windows only right now. The Mac version of 0.8 will probably be coming in a week or so.

notes.title: 0.7.4 - More bendable things, more secrets, and improvements to most levels
notes.notes:
0.7.4 brings changes to almost all levels. This update mainly focuses on including more bendable/breakable objects in the game, as well as addressing parts of the game that players found too difficult, frustrating, or tedious. There are a lot of changes in this release, but highlights include:

[list]
[*] Many levels now feature additional objects that bend/break in response to rift forces. For example, take a look at "Like a Glove", "Hardware Upgrade", or "Crack Shot"
[*] A new ending to the "Group Effort" level
[*] The "Crack Shot" and "High Speed" levels now have some new content
[*] About a dozen new Secrets and 7 new hidden Achievements
[*] LOTS of bug fixes and small changes to make the game more enjoyable
[/list]

For a full list of all changes in this version, click on the version number link at the bottom of the main menu when you open the game.

notes.title: 0.7.3-f2-beta
notes.notes:
## [0.7.3-f2-beta]
 - [Changed] You can now enable/disable the camera jitter caused by Rift forces under General Settings. The default is "Off" for now.
 - [Fixed] Fixed a critical bug where some of the state in a level wasn't being reset if you reloaded the same level from the Level Selection screen.
 - [Fixed] Fixed a bug in Time Trial where it wasn't possible to reset the level in the "OUT OF BOUNDS" portion of the VR demo levels.
 - [Fixed] Fixed an issue where a significant framerate drop would occur if many explosions all triggered at once.

notes.title: Gravia - 0.7.3-f1-beta
notes.notes:
Implemented some changes to the way physics objects are updated, to make everything move more smoothly. This should result in a noticeably smoother experience at higher framerates. Also, more small improvements mainly based on feedback from RockLeeSmile.

## [0.7.3-f1-beta]
 - [Changed] (GRAVIABUG-2) Implemented some changes to the way physics objects are updated, to make everything move more smoothly. This should result in a noticeably smoother experience at higher framerates.
 - [Changed] Made the correct direction to go at the start of Reality Check very obvious. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Moved "Spin Off" a little later in the game, to break up the string of missile levels a bit. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Made the initial drop in "Missile Guidance" easier by providing more room to fall safely. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Adjusted the second room in Retrograde to be a little easier, by adding a platform to provide some visibility. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Corrected some inconsistencies in the placement of lights in "Rift Blocker" tile levels. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Small adjustment to secondary texture on "personnel" area walls/ceilings, to make them tile less noticeably. (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Some keyboards in Leap of Faith were rotated the wrong way. :) (Thanks, RockLeeSmile)
 - [Changed] Another adjustment to a part of Group Effort that everyone's always doing "wrong" and getting frustrated by. 
 - [Changed] Made the junk room in "Hardware Upgrade" a bit bigger to be more visually appealing, and less deadly.
 - [Changed] Explosions now have a larger visual effect, to better match their actual explosive range. This doesn't change the range of the explosions' force/damage.
 - [Changed] Small tweak to the end of "Double Jeopardy", changing from a pressure plate to a press and hold button, to make it less tedious.

notes.title: 0.7.2 Released - A few Achievements, and other improvements
notes.notes:
## [0.7.2-beta] 2021-03-20
[list]
[*][Added] Introduced initial support for Steam Achievements. There are only three right now. I'll gradually expand this in future updates. Achievement icons are also just placeholders for now.
[*][Added] Audio setting to disable the "beep beep beeep" sound effect when low health, in case people don't like hearing it.
[*][Changed] Adjusted the Time Trial goal times on "Like a Glove" after a recent adjustment to the level's layout. 
[*][Changed] Changed the upward portion of "High G" to more reasonably require the use of a second Rift to get up.
[*][Changed] Small tweak to "Run the Gauntlet" to make it more clear how to get passed the barrier gates.
[*][Changed] Adjusted the beginning of "Reality Check" to make one of the goals more clear.  
[*][Changed] Updated the "Hard Armor" message in Acrophobia, temporarily, to at least avoid an inconsistency later until I fully clarify things. (Thanks, deee)
[*][Changed] Swapped out a section of "Fog Warning" to hopefully be a bit more interesting.
[*][Changed] Rift Launcher in "First Gen" now plays a claxon before firing, to keep people from being so surprised.
[*][Changed] Some slight improvements to "Leap of Faith" to increase the chances that players will see the important things when they happen.
[*][Changed] Made the hole in the floor in "Exothermic" more noticeable. Too many players were missing it, and feeling annoyed by it.
[*][Changed] Small tweak to "Critical Mass" to make it more explicit/obvious when the platform doors open.
[*][Changed] Small adjustments to "Wallbreaker" to make a failure sound more obvious. 
[*][Changed] Recommended graphics preset determination has been adjusted slightly to require a higher amount of VRAM to recommend Max and High settings. This is because previously, low end machines with only 2GB of VRAM would have been considered "High".
[*][Changed] Updated the "low health" warning sound to avoid similarities to a certain sound in another popular video game. (Thanks, ultimategamer95)
[*][Changed] Rift Launchers now have a more noticable sound effect play when they fire, to make it easier to know it's about to happen. (Thanks, deee)
[*][Changed] The option to restart the demo from the beginning, for speedrunners, now requires confirmation. Regular players were button mashing and resetting the demo unintentionally without knowing what was happening. (Thanks, Stacose Gaming)
[*][Changed] Robotic Soldier is now 10% less lethal. In practice this means you can take one hit from him, if you're at full health, without dying. This was done to ease the stress of those encounters, where previously one mistake meant restarting.
[*][Fixed] Fixed a minor bug where the player's hand would sway back and forth when standing still in an elevator.
[*][Fixed] (GRAVIABUG-1) Fixed a major bug where the player could fall out of the elevator in "Group Effort". (Thanks, Kikaiki)
[*][Fixed] (GRAVIABUG-3) Fixed a bug in "Barrier to Entry" where the player could get stuck against the wall, held by the Rift, unable to move. (Thanks, Forszili)
[*][Fixed] Fixed a bug where players using a Controller/Gamepad would get locked up after seeing the "Time Trial Unlocked" screen. 
[/list]
